clusters.description: List of clusters to define for ClusterSSH. Each cluster groups hosts for convenient simultaneous access.

name.description: Unique name for the cluster (e.g., 'web', 'db-servers'). Must be a single word without spaces or special characters.

hosts.description: List of hostnames, IPs, or SSH aliases (as in ~/.ssh/config) to include in this cluster.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the cluster's purpose.
